tools.name: task_lifecycle_recurring_suspend
tools.description: Canonical action: recurring suspend (task_lifecycle_recurring_suspend). Suspend an active or draft recurring task definition.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id suspending the recurrence.

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for suspending the recurrence definition.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_recurring_retire
tools.description: Canonical action: recurring retire (task_lifecycle_recurring_retire). Retire a recurring task definition.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id retiring the recurrence.

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for retiring the recurrence definition.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_recurring_trigger
tools.description: Canonical action: recurring trigger (task_lifecycle_recurring_trigger). Manually trigger a recurring task definition and create one normal opened task instance.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id triggering the recurrence.

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for manually triggering the recurrence.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_recurring_runs
tools.description: Canonical action: recurring runs (task_lifecycle_recurring_runs). List generated runs for a recurring task definition.

limit.description: Maximum runs to return. Defaults to 20.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_set_routing
tools.description: Canonical action: set routing (task_lifecycle_set_routing). Route an opened task to a target role, preferred agent, and/or relative priority without claiming it as that agent.

task_number.description: Task number to route. Must currently be opened.

actor_agent_id.description: Architect/operator agent id performing the routing mutation.

target_role.description: Optional target role. Pass null to clear.

preferred_agent_id.description: Optional preferred agent id. Pass null to clear.

relative_priority.description: Optional relative priority for workboard ranking.

reason.description: Reason/authority basis for the routing change.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_test_mcp_tool
tools.description: Canonical action: test mcp tool (task_lifecycle_test_mcp_tool). Spawn a fresh MCP server process and invoke a single tool to verify code changes without restarting the live session server.

server_path.description: Path to the MCP server script relative to site root (e.g., "tools/task-lifecycle/task-mcp-server.mjs").

tool_name.description: Tool name to invoke on the spawned server.

timeout_seconds.description: Fresh server invocation timeout in seconds. Defaults to 10, max 300.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_run_tests
tools.description: Canonical action: run tests (task_lifecycle_run_tests). Run an approved test selector through Test MCP and record structured test evidence on a task.

selector.description: Test selector: task-lifecycle, typed-mcp, operator-surface, or all. Defaults to task-lifecycle.

task_number.description: Task number to attach structured test evidence to.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-test timeout in seconds. Defaults to 120, max 300.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_compatibility_reconcile
tools.description: Bounded, idempotent reconciliation of historical compatibility review records. Materializes missing task projections, repairs closure evidence from admitted outcomes, and releases stale assignments without creating new review outcomes.

task_numbers.description: Optional explicit task numbers to reconcile; maximum 100. Omit to scan at most limit legacy-review records.

limit.description: Maximum legacy compatibility records to inspect when task_numbers is omitted; defaults to 25 and is capped at 100.

dry_run.description: Plan the bounded reconciliation without mutating SQLite or task projections.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_guidance
tools.description: Show canonical operating guidance for task lifecycle workflows: ordinary work, blocked work, payloads, review/dependency state, and truthful closeout reporting.

workflow.description: Optional guidance section: ordinary_task, blocked_task, payloads, review_and_dependencies, closeout_truthfulness, or all.

tool.description: Optional lifecycle tool name for tool-specific guidance, such as task_lifecycle_submit_work or task_lifecycle_report_blocked.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_payload_schema
tools.description: Show accepted payload_ref shapes, inline length thresholds, and examples for lifecycle create, finish, closeout, blocked-report, review, and evidence payloads.

tool.description: Optional lifecycle tool name such as task_lifecycle_review or task_lifecycle_finish.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_inspect_range
tools.description: Read-only compact inspection for an explicit task-number range or chapter membership, including closure/evidence posture.

start_task_number.description: First task number in the inclusive range.

end_task_number.description: Last task number in the inclusive range.

chapter_id.description: Optional chapter id to inspect instead of a numeric range.

limit.description: Maximum tasks to return; defaults to 50.

include_body.description: Include task body snippets. Defaults false.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_report_blocked
tools.description: Record exact blockers for claimed work without implying finish/completion. Defaults to deferring the task after writing a blocked report. For long next_action/blocker details, create a payload and call with payload_ref plus top-level task_number and agent_id.

blockers.description: Specific blocker objects, including evidence limits or required external decisions.

next_action.description: Concrete action needed to unblock continuation. Inline strings over the governed inline threshold should be carried in payload_ref.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref carrying long reason, blockers, next_action, or defer. Payload fields are merged with top-level arguments; top-level task_number and agent_id win.

defer.description: When false, record the blocked report without transitioning to deferred. Defaults true.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_chapter_add_task
tools.description: Add an existing task to a named chapter membership list. Defaults to appending after the current maximum order_index.

order_index.description: Optional explicit order index. Used as an insertion point only when append is false.

append.description: When omitted or true, append after the current maximum order_index.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_chapter_show
tools.description: Show task memberships for one chapter, ordered by order_index.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_submit_work
tools.description: Compound governed work submission helper: optionally claim, write execution/verification notes, prove criteria, admit evidence, and finish while preserving primitive lifecycle records and gates.

task_number.description: Task number to submit work for.

execution_notes.description: Substantive authored ## Execution Notes replacement text.

reviewer.description: Optional admitted reviewer agent id or unique reviewer role alias. Ordinary task finish defaults to the first reviewer-capable roster agent, then to the reviewer role, and always generates review-contract dependency work.

changed_files.description: Changed-file evidence for finish. Mutually exclusive with no_files_changed.

no_files_changed.description: Declare no files changed for legitimate no-edit work. Mutually exclusive with changed_files.

claim.description: When true, call task_lifecycle_claim first. Defaults true unless task is already claimed.

prove_criteria.description: When true, call task_lifecycle_prove_criteria after writing notes. Defaults true.

admit_evidence.description: When true, call task_lifecycle_admit_evidence before finish. Defaults true.

finish.description: When true, call task_lifecycle_finish after evidence admission. Defaults true.

resume_existing_work.description: Resume a prior submit_work attempt without rewriting notes or duplicating proof/admission. Reuses the latest report by this agent and the existing substantive task sections, then performs remaining requested lifecycle transitions.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long execution_notes, verification, summary, changed_files, or guard packets. Payload fields are merged with top-level arguments; top-level task_number and agent_id win.

auto_materialize_payload.description: Opt-in fallback for one-call long-field submit_work. When true and payload_ref is absent, the surface creates an immutable payload artifact from companion fields before executing; default false preserves inline length refusal.

authority_basis.description: Required by underlying claim when crossing role/preferred-agent gates.

kind.description: Authority kind: operator_direct_instruction, directed_obligation, or task_owner_handoff.

recovery_truthfulness.description: Passed through to task_lifecycle_finish when recovery truthfulness is triggered.

self_certification.description: Passed through to evidence admission/finish when self-certification gates are triggered.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_evidence_supersede
tools.description: Submit immutable replacement execution evidence for a task already in review. The original report remains preserved; reviewers are directed to the replacement evidence.

task_number.description: In-review task number whose execution evidence changed after submission.

agent_id.description: Agent id submitting the replacement evidence.

supersedes_report_id.description: Existing report id being superseded for review purposes.

artifact_uri.description: Durable URI of the replacement evidence artifact.

summary.description: Short truthful summary of the replacement implementation/evidence.

verification_summary.description: Focused verification performed after the replacement evidence was produced.

changed_files.description: Changed files represented by the replacement evidence. Omit only with no_files_changed=true.

no_files_changed.description: Set true only when the replacement evidence changed no task-owned files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_dependency_declare
tools.description: Declare that an existing parent task is gated by an existing required task. Optional outcome_contract attaches the required task outcome shape; normal agents should prefer task-native helpers such as submit_work.reviewer when available.

parent_task_number.description: Parent task number that will be blocked by this dependency.

required_task_number.description: Existing required task number that must admit a satisfying outcome.

kind.description: Dependency kind, for example review, verification, operator_decision, or downstream_work.

satisfying_outcomes.description: Outcomes on the required task that satisfy this dependency.

outcome_contract.description: Optional outcome contract for the required task. Fields: outcome_type, allowed_outcomes, satisfying_outcomes, blocking_outcomes, required_fields, capability_requirement.

dependency_id.description: Optional stable dependency id. Defaults to a deterministic id from parent, required task, and kind.

tools.name: mcp_payload_create
tools.description: Create immutable transient MCP payload revision v1 under .ai/tmp/mcp-payloads/workspace.

payload_id.description: Optional stable id segment. Defaults to a generated id.

payload.description: Normal route for clients that can transmit nested objects: the non-empty domain object to store, e.g. {"payload":{"summary":"..."}}. Do not send with payload_json unless payload is exactly {} as a client placeholder.

payload_json.description: String route for clients that cannot transmit free-form nested objects, especially OpenCode: JSON object text, e.g. "{\"summary\":\"...\"}". Authoritative when present; may be accompanied only by payload:{} as a placeholder.

allow_empty.description: Set true only when intentionally creating an empty payload object.

tools.name: mcp_payload_show
tools.description: Show an immutable transient MCP payload revision by ref.

tools.name: mcp_payload_derive
tools.description: Derive a new immutable payload revision by applying an optional object overlay and explicit JSON Pointer deletions.

overlay.description: Optional recursive object overlay. Null remains a value and never means deletion. Do not send with overlay_json unless overlay is exactly {} as a client placeholder.

overlay_json.description: Optional JSON-string overlay route for clients that cannot transmit free-form nested objects. Authoritative when present; may be accompanied only by overlay:{} as a placeholder.

delete_paths.description: Optional RFC 6901-encoded object-field paths to delete after applying the overlay, e.g. ["/preferred_role", "/constraints/model"]. Array traversal is not supported. At least one overlay route or delete path is required.

tools.name: mcp_payload_validate
tools.description: Validate that a payload ref exists, is well-formed, and is within size limits.

tools.name: mcp_output_show
tools.description: Read a materialized MCP output ref with offset/limit paging.

ref.description: Materialized output ref, e.g. mcp_output:<id>. Alias: output_ref.

offset.description: Character offset into the materialized JSON output.

limit.description: Maximum output characters to return; the transport hard-caps this value.

timeout_ms.description: Strict upper bound for reading and validating the materialized output file.

lifecycle.reason: Tool and runtime changes require mcp_loader_surface_restart for the bound task-lifecycle surface.
Tool and runtime changes require mcp_loader_surface_restart for the bound task-lifecycle surface.

tools.name: worker_guidance
tools.description: Show model-facing operating guidance for worker-delegation MCP workflows.

workflow.description: Optional workflow name or area to focus guidance on.

tool.description: Optional tool name for tool-specific guidance.

tools.name: worker_output_show
tools.description: Read a materialized worker MCP output ref with offset/limit paging.

tools.name: worker_operator_affordances
tools.description: Return UI-neutral operator affordances for rendering worker run dashboards, launch controls, artifact refs, and recovery actions.

tools.name: worker_policy_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the active worker delegation policy, including narada-agent-runtime-server Site binding markers and environment projection.

tools.name: worker_cognition_defaults_inspect
tools.description: Inspect legacy provider-scoped low, medium, and high cognition defaults. Canonical narada-agent-runtime-server runs use capabilities from their immutable Narada invocation plan instead.

tools.name: worker_cognition_defaults_update
tools.description: Atomically set a legacy provider-scoped cognition default for compatibility runtimes. Canonical narada-agent-runtime-server runs do not consume this registry.

tools.name: worker_config_resolve
tools.description: Resolve worker run inputs without launching a worker, including narada-agent-runtime-server Site binding status.

max_run_ms.description: Hard worker runtime deadline enforced by the native authority.

wait_for_completion.description: Return after bounded child completion polling when true; false returns the accepted running record immediately.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum inline completion wait when wait_for_completion is true.

tools.name: worker_run
tools.description: Start one new worker run for one delegated instruction.

max_run_ms.description: Hard worker runtime deadline enforced by the native authority.

wait_for_completion.description: Return after bounded child completion polling when true; false returns the accepted running record immediately.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum inline completion wait when wait_for_completion is true.

tools.name: worker_edit
tools.description: Start one edit-capable worker run shortcut using write authority. The agent runtime resolves a canonical plan during preflight when no invocation_plan_ref is supplied.

site_root.description: Explicit Narada Site root for narada-agent-runtime-server workers. Defaults to nearest Site marker above cwd.

invocation_plan_ref.description: Optional immutable canonical Narada invocation-plan reference. When omitted, narada-agent-runtime-server resolves and admits its plan during canonical preflight.

provider.description: Legacy compatibility provider selector. Rejected for runtime narada-agent-runtime-server; that runtime uses the canonical invocation plan.

required_mcp_tools.description: Exact MCP tool names to project for narada-agent-runtime-server workers. Other runtimes report the request as unprojectable.

wait_for_completion.description: When true, wait boundedly for completion. Defaults to false so delegation returns promptly with run_id.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum synchronous wait before returning the recoverable running run_id. Defaults to 180000.

exit_interview.description: Ask the worker to include ergonomics feedback in its final output.

tools.name: worker_resume
tools.description: Continue one existing worker session.

mode.description: Non-mechanical task mode. Defaults to audit_only for read authority and implement for write/command authority.

output_contract.description: Optional caller-owned structured output contract merged into the worker output contract.

site_root.description: Explicit Narada Site root for narada-agent-runtime-server workers. Defaults to nearest Site marker above cwd.

invocation_plan_ref.description: Optional immutable canonical Narada invocation-plan reference. When omitted, narada-agent-runtime-server resolves and admits its plan during canonical preflight.

provider.description: Legacy compatibility provider selector. Rejected for runtime narada-agent-runtime-server; that runtime uses the canonical invocation plan.

cognition.description: Legacy compatibility cognition tier; canonical offerings declare their own plan-scoped capability vocabulary.

wait_for_completion.description: When true, wait boundedly for completion. Defaults to false so delegation returns promptly with run_id.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum synchronous wait before returning the recoverable running run_id. Defaults to 180000.

max_run_ms.description: Maximum worker runtime. The effective value is capped by the worker policy.

exit_interview.description: Ask the worker to include ergonomics feedback in its final output.

verification_budget.description: Advisory verification budget. Workers classify commands as focused or broad, respect stop discipline, and report budget adherence.

focus.description: Default command scope expected for verification.

test_budget.description: Advisory test budget. Use for focused package-local checks before broader suites; workers report broad unrelated failures separately.

focus.description: Default command scope expected for verification.

preflight_paths.description: Optional path capability checks recorded before the worker starts.

required_mcp_tools.description: Tool names the worker must have. For narada-agent-runtime-server, worker-delegation projects these through NARADA_WORKER_MCP_CONFIG; other runtimes record them as worker-verification requirements.

tools.name: worker_run_status
tools.description: Inspect a worker run by run id without waiting for completion.

tools.name: worker_run_reap
tools.description: Governed cleanup for a running worker record: abort a managed active run when possible, or persist a terminal orphaned/cancelled result with evidence for a stale run.

force.description: Allow reaping a non-stale running run. Defaults false.

site_root.description: Optional authorized Narada Site root whose worker run store should be reaped.

tools.name: worker_runs_list
tools.description: List recent worker runs so callers can rediscover outstanding run ids.

site_scope.description: Runs are filtered by the server-bound Site root; caller-supplied cross-site identity is not accepted.

tools.name: worker_run_wait
tools.description: Wait briefly for one worker run to finish, returning the latest run status on timeout.

tools.name: worker_run_batch
tools.description: Start multiple worker runs from one request and return compact per-run status plus launch diagnostics.

max_run_ms.description: Hard worker runtime deadline enforced by the native authority.

wait_for_completion.description: Return after bounded child completion polling when true; false returns the accepted running record immediately.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum inline completion wait when wait_for_completion is true.

tools.name: worker_run_wait_batch
tools.description: Wait briefly for multiple worker runs and return compact per-run statuses plus normalized synthesis.

tools.name: worker_runs_synthesize
tools.description: Return a normalized cross-worker synthesis for completed or running worker run ids.

tools.name: worker_dashboard_describe
tools.description: Return a read-only local dashboard/API descriptor plus compact run topology, status, result refs, pending joins, and event stream data for one run or all active runs.

mode.description: Defaults to single_run when run_id is provided, otherwise all_active.

run_ids.description: Optional explicit run set when mode is all_active. Defaults to all known runs filtered to active unless include_terminal is true.

include_terminal.description: Include completed, failed, cancelled, and completed_with_errors runs. Defaults to true for single_run and false for all_active.
